title: create_vfx_material specification
description: Goal-level VFX material instance creation from master templates + element presets (ADR-0008). Elemental variants are one parameterized family via element + modifiers, not per-element tools. Epic MaterialTools primitives are internalised — agents submit this specification only. Owned by WS-08.

purpose.description: Semantic role selecting master template and default parameters. Examples: fireball_core, fireball_ribbon_trail, elemental_projectile_core, elemental_projectile_trail, impact_decal, ribbon_trail.

element.description: Elemental palette for parameterized variation (fire, water, wind, earth, ice, lightning, arcane, custom). Aligns with WS-15 template inputs.element and niagara.create_niagara_effect.element — one family, not per-element actions.

features.description: VFX material features from master prompt §6. Open-ended tokens; new values extend master wiring, not schema forks. Examples: radial_falloff, animated_noise, fresnel, erosion, depth_fade, distortion, panning_textures, flow_maps, flipbook_subuv, dynamic_color, dynamic_intensity.

master_template.description: Override master material path. When omitted, resolved from purpose + element via WS-15 element templates (templates/elements/).

instance_name.description: Material instance asset name (without path). Prefer envelope target.asset_path for the full package path.

folder_path.description: Package folder when envelope target is omitted (e.g. /Game/__UeremcpTests/Materials).

parameter_overrides.description: MI scalar/vector/texture overrides applied after element defaults. Keys match master MaterialExpression parameter names.

textures.description: Texture slot bindings: MainTexture, NoiseTexture, FlowMap, MaskTexture. Path or procedural generate spec (delegates to create_procedural_texture).

modifiers.description: Named WS-15 element modifiers applied after element defaults (e.g. crystalline_fragments, reduce_trail_persistence, boost_impact, preserve_networking). Matches niagara.projectile.elemental.v1 supported_modifiers.

recompile.description: Recompile parent material and verify empty error list before reporting created_and_validated.

preview.description: Optional lit-plane preview render (REAgentTools capture_workflow pattern).
